We are given a $4 \times 4$ square of 16 cells, and we need to cut out **4 white three-cell corner shapes**. The problem asks for the **minimum number of red cells** (colored by Petya) required to block Vitya from making this cut.

verified_state: The board is a $4 \times 4$ square with 16 cells.
Vitya wants to cut out 4 white three-cell corner shapes.
Petya colors some cells red to prevent this, and we seek the minimum number of red cells.
reflection.error_step: A "corner shape" can be interpreted as **a 3-cell rectangle**, meaning:
reflection.error_reason: A three-cell corner shape is an L-tromino (a 2x2 square missing one cell), not a 3-cell rectangle; a 3x1 or 1x3 rectangle with one cell missing would have only two cells.
reflection.new_direction: Treat the corner shape as an L-tromino and determine the minimum number of red cells that intersects every possible placement of four disjoint L-trominoes on the 4x4 board.
